scope: Full NVIDIA TE 2.20.2 mHC forward/backward; no DeepSeek mHC calls
operations: final stream head via NVIDIA projection/scale/aggregate
layout: Persistent B,T,D,4; phi columns interleaved once at initialization; same effective seed weights
numerical_conventions: TE uses float32 machine epsilon for RMS, no extra pre-gate epsilon, and log-space Sinkhorn; unmodified upstream sources checked by SHA
fusion: Test native per-invocation FP32 gradient buffer against unfused path, repeated backward, and activation checkpointing; enable only after gate
tests: 16 controlled checks (6 NVIDIA projection +10 complete-pipeline) plus6 native full checks =22. Includes explicit fresh-context allocator and checkpoint regressions.
timing: Same GPU, same 8-layer D512/4-head/2K/32K/FineWeb/seed42/native MuonAdamW, micro16 accum1; 20 warmup +60 normal timed +26 diagnostic updates each; fresh process per model
limitations: Embedding replication uses standard PyTorch because TE has no standalone expand-to-streams API; parameter containers/init/optimizer remain local nanochat choices
first_gate: 7547609.0: 34/35 passed; retained failed attempt records the corrected finite-iteration Sinkhorn assertion
tma_allocator_adapter: TE process-global init guard conflicts with Triton 3.6 ContextVar allocator during autograd checkpoint recompute. Install the same torch.empty CUDA allocator only when current context has NullAllocator; preserve existing allocators.
